scripts.setup: npm run fetch:lean && npm run install:wasi && npm run build:demo
scripts.quickstart: npm run prepare:irpkg -- examples/quickstart.virpkg.json && node scripts/quickstart-url.mjs
scripts.prepare:pages: npm run prepare:irpkg -- examples/quickstart.virpkg.json examples/fib.virpkg.json examples/mergesort.virpkg.json
scripts.build:local-artifact: npm run build:demo:release && npm run prepare:pages && npm run package:local-artifact
scripts.build:sdk-artifact: npm run build:demo:release && npm run package:sdk-artifact
scripts.build:size-site: node scripts/render-wasm-size-report.mjs web/public/vir-upstream.wasm web/public/vir-upstream.dev.wasm build/upstream-probe/link.map web/dist/size
scripts.build:surface-site: npm run analyze:surface -- build/vir-surface/lean-libraries.json build/vir-surface/lean-libraries.md && npm run render:surface -- build/vir-surface/lean-libraries.json web/dist/surface
scripts.build:frontier-size-site: npm run analyze:frontier-size -- --plan scripts/frontier-size-plan.json --surface-links web/dist/surface/data/size-links.json --output-prefix build/frontier-size-costs/site
scripts.build:analysis-site: npm run build:surface-site && npm run build:frontier-size-site && npm run render:surface -- build/vir-surface/lean-libraries.json web/dist/surface --frontier-costs build/frontier-size-costs/site.json && npm run build:size-site -- --surface-links web/dist/surface/data/size-links.json --frontier-costs build/frontier-size-costs/site.json
scripts.build:site: npm run build:demo:release && npm run prepare:pages && npm run package:sdk-artifact && npm run package:local-artifact && vite build --base /lean-vir/ && npm run build:analysis-site
scripts.test: npm run test:mailbox && npm run test:bench && npm run test:surface && npm run check:package-abi && npm run test:package-ir-builders && npm run check:ir-codec-tags && npm run check:native-externs && npm run check:client-native-externs && npm run check:boundary-registry && npm run check:native-wrappers && npm run check:api-coverage && npm run test:lake && npm run test:wasm-extensions && npm run build:demo && npm run test:env-lookup:wasm-pair && npm run test:upstream:no-build && npm run test:infoview && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:fixtures:no-build
scripts.test:bench: node --test scripts/bench-artifact-cache.test.mjs scripts/bench-differential.test.mjs scripts/bench-env-lookup.test.mjs scripts/bench-paired.test.mjs scripts/bench-utils.test.mjs scripts/std-format-values.test.mjs
scripts.test:surface: node scripts/surface-report-smoke.mjs && node --test scripts/analyze-surface-graph.test.mjs scripts/client-native-surface-profile.test.mjs scripts/compare-surface-reports.test.mjs scripts/frontier-size-costs.test.mjs scripts/render-target-surface-index.test.mjs scripts/surface-boundary-family.test.mjs scripts/surface-report-schema.test.mjs
scripts.test:site: npm run build:site && npm run test:pages
scripts.test:benchmark-pages: npm --prefix benchmarks/prettyM-web run test:pages -- --directory ../../web/dist/benchmarks --deploy prettyM=default && npm --prefix benchmarks/prettyM-web run test:pages:browser -- --directory ../../web/dist --base-path /benchmarks/ --example prettyM --variant default
scripts.test:infoview: npm run check:infoview-bundle && lake build Vir.Infoview Vir.Infoview.ImportedHelperSmoke && lake env lean scripts/smoke-infoview-lean.lean && node scripts/smoke-infoview-widget.mjs
scripts.test:upstream: npm run build:demo && npm run test:upstream:no-build
